T: What's your damage. Have a slushie.
D: A teenager falls in with a dangerous new boyfriend who has a deadly answer to the school's popular clique.
P: Serve the drinks when J.D. and Veronica stop at the convenience store for slushies.
S: Crunchy roasted corn kernels tossed in butter, chilli and lime salt. Soak 300g dried corn kernels overnight, drain and dry well.
Corn kernels soaked overnight, dried, fried at 180C until puffed and crunchy, tossed with salt and a little chilli.
the red scrunchie that marks the leader
Baguette sliced and toasted with olive oil, spread with whipped ricotta, topped with fresh raspberries crushed with a little sugar and a drizzle of honey.
M: the high school cafeteria where the Heathers rule
Chicken breasts pounded thin, crumbed in panko and fried in butter and oil until golden, with buttery mashed potato, peas and a pan gravy.
Beef and pork ragù simmered 2 hours with tomato and red wine, layered with lasagne sheets, béchamel and mozzarella, baked at 180C for 45 minutes and rested 20.
W: Red velvet cupcakes of buttermilk, cocoa and red colouring baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with cream cheese frosting, a red sugar dot on top.
K: Cherry juice and lemonade blended with plenty of ice until slushy, poured into tall cups with a straw and a spoon.

s.how: Soak 300g dried corn kernels overnight, drain and dry well. Fry at 180C in batches until puffed and crunchy, about 6 minutes. Toss with melted butter, chilli powder, lime zest and salt.

s.note: the red scrunchie that marks the leader
s.how: Slice a baguette, brush with oil and toast. Spread with 200g whipped ricotta. Top with 200g raspberries crushed with a little sugar and drizzle with honey.

m.how: Simmer 500g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 2 tins tomatoes and red wine for 2 hours. Make béchamel with 50g butter, 50g flour and 600ml milk. Layer with 300g lasagne sheets and 250g mozzarella and bake at 180C for 45 minutes. Rest 20 minutes.

w.how: Beat 125g butter and 200g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 200ml buttermilk and red colouring. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Pipe 250g cream cheese beaten with 250g icing sugar and add a red sugar dot.

d.how: Blend 500ml cherry juice with 300ml lemonade and 4 cups of ice until slushy. Pour into tall cups with a straw and a spoon. How very.
